requirements.description: Annual 2004–2012 eligible firm-year samples for Big4, internal-control weakness and analyst-following tests, including foreign/financial exclusions and the reported full/matched sample counts.

required_coverage.population: U.S. nonfinancial firms with available Compustat, Audit Analytics and/or IBES records under each treatment sample
required_coverage.detail: The source reports full-sample and matched sample sizes by treatment/outcome but does not give exact firm-level inclusion lists or all attrition decisions.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The sample counts are reported, but firm-level inclusion/attrition and source-link lists are not supplied; exact sample membership is unverified.

requirements.description: Propensity-score matching design for the 1:1 matched regressions: estimated logit scores, nearest score match without replacement, caliper 0.03 and treatment-specific matched sets.

required_coverage.population: Eligible treatment/control firms in each of Big4, internal-control weakness and analyst-following settings
required_coverage.detail: The paper specifies 1:1 without replacement and a 0.03 caliper; exact tie-breaking/order, unmatched IDs and any random initialization are not documented.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The matching design is described but exact matched-pair identities and tie-breaking/order are not published.

requirements.description: Annual Compustat fundamentals for all 2004–2012 main regressions and 2003–2012 construction windows: assets, income, sales, current assets/liabilities, debt, retained earnings, EBIT, working capital, equity, market value, receivables, PPE and identifiers.

required_coverage.population: Sample and eligible comparison firms for 2004–2012; one prior fiscal year is needed for growth and average-asset variables
required_coverage.detail: Includes support propensity-score covariates and Appendix B total accruals, asset, revenue/receivables changes, PPE and denominator inputs.

routes.mapping_notes: Current annual fields and labels expose candidate fundamentals. The paper’s study-vintage definitions, field-period selection, units/average-assets conventions, eligible comparison population and 2003–2012 coverage are not confirmed.
routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator confirmation establishes the exact required years, population and frequency. The one-row probe is not coverage evidence.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Probe proves current field presence only; historical sample coverage and exact source-definition/units are unverified.

requirements.description: Historical Compustat firm coverage start needed to calculate AGE, the number of years the firm has been covered by Compustat as of each observation year.

required_coverage.population: Full Compustat company history before and through 2012 for sample and comparison firms
required_coverage.detail: Beginning history is not bounded by the paper; do not assume the 2003 model-input window is sufficient for AGE.

routes.mapping_notes: The annual Compustat key/date/year fields are present, but complete first-coverage history and start-of-history semantics are not confirmed.
routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator confirmation establishes the exact required years, population and frequency. The one-row probe is not coverage evidence.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The required Compustat history start is unbounded and no coverage confirmation establishes each firm’s first covered year.

requirements.description: Internal-control weakness treatment indicator from audit reports for each 2004–2012 firm-year; classify a firm as treated when its audit report has at least one internal-control weakness.

required_coverage.population: Public-company audit opinions for the internal-control treatment sample and controls
required_coverage.detail: FEED11 candidate fields include control-opinion type, effectiveness, weakness count, fiscal-year-end and company key; exact coding and sample-population mapping remain unverified.

routes.mapping_notes: Current opinion, effectiveness, count, fiscal-end, signature-date and company-key fields are live. Their relationship to the paper’s audit-report weakness indicator and full firm-year population is not verified.
routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator confirmation establishes the exact required years, population and frequency. The one-row probe is not coverage evidence.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The current FEED11 fields are only a candidate for the paper’s weakness coding; semantic coding, company links and 2004–2012 coverage remain unverified.

requirements.description: Engagement auditor identity and Big4 classification for each eligible 2004–2012 firm-year.

required_coverage.population: All eligible main-sample and comparison firms across Big4 tests
required_coverage.detail: Requires auditor identity at the firm-year and a historical Big4 name/code classification, not a generic current name lookup.

routes.mapping_notes: FEED11 has candidate audit-opinion auditor identity fields, but it is not established as a complete source for all main-sample firm-years; exact Big4 name-history mapping is not verified.
routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator confirmation establishes the exact required years, population and frequency. The one-row probe is not coverage evidence.

routes.mapping_notes: FEED01 supplies an auditor-key/name lookup; it does not alone provide the engagement-year assignment or historical Big4 classification.
routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator confirmation establishes the exact required years, population and frequency. The one-row probe is not coverage evidence.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Auditor identity and name lookup fields are present, but full-population engagement linkage, historical classification and period coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: Analyst-following treatment indicator for each firm-year: at least one qualifying analyst follows the company in year t.

required_coverage.population: I/B/E/S U.S. annual earnings-summary records for eligible sample and comparison firms
required_coverage.detail: Analyst count/forecast-period/measurement-date filters and Compustat-to-IBES firm linkage must match the paper’s study vintage.

routes.mapping_notes: Current summary table contains ticker/CUSIP, statistic period, measure, forecast period, number of estimates and forecast end date. Exact year-t availability rule, identifiers and historical coverage remain unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator confirmation establishes the exact required years, population and frequency. The one-row probe is not coverage evidence.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Live summary fields are confirmed, but the analyst-following date rule, IBES-to-Compustat identifier link and firm-year coverage are not confirmed.

requirements.description: Subsequent restatement indicator for year t: whether the firm later issued restated financial statements for fiscal year t.

required_coverage.frequency: restatement event linked to firm fiscal year
required_coverage.population: Financial restatement events for 2004–2012 sample firms, with follow-up through an unknown endpoint
required_coverage.detail: The paper does not bound the subsequent-observation endpoint; preserve the unknown end. Candidate FEED39 carries event, filing, period and company fields.

routes.mapping_notes: Current financial-restatement event/date/type/company fields are present. Classification to the paper’s subsequent restatement indicator, issuer link, study vintage and complete follow-up coverage are unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator confirmation establishes the exact required years, population and frequency. The one-row probe is not coverage evidence.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The restatement follow-up endpoint is unspecified and current event coding/population coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: Date-valid issuer joins across Compustat GVKEY, Audit Analytics COMPANY_FKEY and I/B/E/S TICKER/CUSIP, for 2004–2012 firm-year observations.

required_coverage.population: Eligible main and matched firm-years in each dataset
required_coverage.detail: A valid historical identifier crosswalk is required; static CUSIP/name similarity does not establish a date-valid join.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No exact crosswalk probe or frozen verified route was supplied for COMPANY_FKEY/GVKEY and IBES ticker/CUSIP linkage.
